title: Akbar mera pyara tha
body:
Akbar mera pyara tha
haaye haaye
haaye ali akbar
jivan ka asaasa tha piri ka sahaara tha
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jaane wo kya kya tha
akbar mera pyaara raaj dulaara tha
akbar ki jawaani par sau jaan se fida maadar
ay kaash use dekhun ek baar nazar bharkar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aankhon ka taara tha raaj dulaara tha
ye din the jawaani ke akbar teri shaadi ke
kis tarha lute armaan teri maa dukhiyaari ke
aisa to na socha tha raaj dulaara tha
<<DIVIDER>>
kya khub wo surat thi naana ki shabaahat thi
waabasta bahot tumse apnon ki mohabbat thi
wo sab ka dulaara tha raaj dulaara tha
ek daaghe alam dekar kis samt chale akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kham kiye rokar beta teri raahon par
baba ka ye naala tha raaj dulaara tha
sine me jo bhaala hai is dil me bhi utra hai
kaise ye sahu sadma ye maa ka kaleja hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naazon ka paala tha raaj dulaara tha
maidaan se jo aate tum aur maa ko bulaate tum
paani mein tumhe deti aur pyaas bujhaate tum
kya maa ko pukaara tha raaj dulaara tha
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad teri aaye dil tumko kahaan paaye
itna to bata jaawo maadar ye kahaan jaaye
yun mujhko rulaana tha raaj dulaara tha
jab ali shanaawar ye zikre gham sunaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zaakira ka ye noha har maa ko rulaata hai
gham ye kitna gehra tha raaj dulaara tha
